newsitem.title: USA: PMT Services to acquire organization.
newsitem.headline: PMT Services to acquire organization.

text.p: PMT Services Inc said on Monday that it had signed a letter of intent for PMT to acquire an independent service organization (ISO) with a merchant account portfolio of about 2,000 accounts and $400 million annual charge volume.
PMT declined to name the ISO in its statement that said the transaction is scheduled to be completed December 1 and will be treated as a pooling-of-interests.
Consummation of the transaction is subject to, among other things, the execution of a definitive purchase agreement.
